items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: I took a course from Archie Bly, a correspondence course from Archie Bly on arranging.

ctx.x: Twenty-six, I think. Twenty-eight years. Twenty-eight? Twenty-eight years and you renew it for another twenty-eight. That's fifty-six. Yeah. Well, it's about time for it to be renewed now. Yeah, the time might be coming up and be worth sharing.

Worthwhile doing. And while I was with Solid Stan's band, I did some of the arranging. We had, when he developed the larger band, we had Cecil Thornton, he was arranging. Fats Pichon did quite a bit of arranging for the band. In fact, Pichon really instructed me. I took a course from Archie Bly, a correspondence course from Archie Bly on arranging. And Fats Pichon coached me along with that. And Cecil Thornton helped me out quite a bit. And I learned to write some.
Well, I wanted to check once more on the Solid Stan band. Did you play banjo or was it bass in the Biloxi?
